messages.subject: Tree with Singleton nodes (read.tree fails)
parts:
Hi All,

I am trying to plot trees that have singleton nodes using ggtree. I am unable to import them using read.tree because it does not support singleton nodes and cannot graph them when I read them in with read.newick, which does support singleton nodes, because it is not a valid way to read a tree in for ggtree.

I have tried using phylocom phyclean to remove the singleton nodes, but it seems to have a known bug that has not been resolved.

I have tried changing them to nexus files and reading them in, and I get the same error. 

The file in question is attached.

Does anyone have any suggestions of how to get around this?

Kind regards,
Kirston

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Tree with Singleton nodes (read.tree fails)
parts:
This file contains tip labels like this:

'2115-DRn-24 S89 L001 R1 001 (paired).Clean.Paired.Reads sampled contig 1 consensus'

This can't be parsed as newick file, since parentheses is reserved to use in grouping nodes.

If you substitute '(paired)' to something like '_paired_', you can read the file and visualize the tree directly in ggtree.


​
